**Postdoc funding opportunities at SciLifeLab in Sweden**

**The call opens on 7 January 2025**

Candidates are eligible to apply if they have not been in Sweden for more than
12 months in the last 3 years and have received their PhD less than 3 years
ago. They provide a match-making portfolio to find a suitable research group for
a candidate’s project.
<br>
<br>

**Lectureship in Bioinformatics at the University of Skövde, Sweden**

**Dead-line for applications is 6th of January 2025**

The position as a lecturer primarily involves teaching in bioinformatics and the
administration associated with these tasks. Additional duties may also be
included in the position.

:::
